description:
FILED s543g (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22) -- found while A/B-ing #540's fix over perl-tests/local.t (line 765, `local $_[0]`) and args.t (70, 75); PRE-EXISTING on 8959afae.

REPRODUCER:
    sub f { local $_[0] = 5; print "in:$_[0] " } my $v = 1; f($v); print "v=$v\n";
    $_ = "T"; sub h { local $_[0]; print defined $_[0] ? "def" : "undef", " $_\n" } h(7);
        perl  in:5 v=1 / undef T        base  in:1 v=1 / def (empty $_: it localized $_ to 5 / to undef)
(s543g scratch/s543g/probes/m1c/c01_underscore.pl.)  CAUSE: PPI makes `$_` / `$^H` / `$+` a MAGIC token, and Pl::Stmt::local_elem_base and Parser2::_local_target_item took only a Symbol before a subscript, so the statement fell to the items reading and localized the Magic token as a scalar.

=== DONE (s543g) ===
Fixed in s543g WIP 1 (the same reading as #540: a Magic token before a subscript is a named container, Pl::Stmt::local_elem_base + _local_target_item).  Guard Pl/t/local-elem-02.t M5 (`local $_[0] = 5` reads 5, the caller's $v untouched; fails on 8959afae).  Corpus: perl-tests/local.t:765 and args.t:70/75 now localize the element of @_.
subject: SILENT WRONG (fixed s543g): `local $_[0]`, `local $^H{x}`, `local $+{n}` -- a PUNCTUATION aggregate's element as a `local` target localized the SCALAR (`$_`, `$^H`, `$+`) and assigned the value there
triage_reason: local of a punctuation aggregate element localized the scalar
